steps.text: Speak to either dwarves on either side of the White Wolf Mountain. Note: Starting on the west side makes travelling by foot easier.
chat: 1. I was wondering what was down those stairs?
3. If you were my friend I wouldn't mind it.
1. And how am I meant to do that?

steps.text: If you need garlic, go to Seers' Village and take it from the house south-west of the bank (it spawns on the table).

Bring a spade and make your way to McGrubor's Wood (either enter through the back or teleport to fairy ring ALS if you completed at least half of Fairytale II - Cure a Queen) to gather 3 red vine worm. You can collect them by checking the vine just west of the fairy ring ALS.
Either walk south to Hemenster or teleport to the Ranging Guild via your combat bracelet and go north-west.
If you don't have a Fishing Rod, purchase one from Grandpa Jack for in the house outside Hemenster entrance.
Enter Hemenster with the Fishing pass in your inventory.
Put a Garlic in the pipes to the north. Make sure to finish the dialogue.
Pay Bonzo 5 coins. Wait for the Sinister Stranger to move away from the pipes. Start fishing and wait for the contest to end.
After winning the contest, make your way back to the dwarf and show him the trophy.
